messages:
Jamie: Quick sync — after yesterday's db failover incident and the postmortem draft, I think our IC checklist needs a leaner "first 10 mins" section. Current one is too bloated. Thoughts?

Ruchi: +1, I spent too long hunting for the right runbook section during the page. We need an abbreviated triage card with exact queries & k8s commands.

Miguel: Agreed. Also add a "customer impact triage" rubric: how to map alerts to customer-facing impact levels (P1/P2). Yesterday we were debating whether to page CS.

Ana (SRE): here's a strawman for "first 10":
```
1) Confirm alert source & scope (metrics/healthcheck/logs)
2) Identify service owner & invocation path
3) Verify replication/leader status (pg_isready / leader-election)
4) Failover? Only if >N% errors after 3 checks
5) Page IC, set severity, paste short summary
```
We should embed exact commands.

Priya: can we add a line for "runbook quick-links" to jump to the exact section? maybe link to anchors in Confluence.

Jamie: yes. Also need standardized handoff note template for off-shift. Proposed template:
```
Handoff summary:
- What happened (1-2 lines)
- Current state
- Outstanding action items + owners
- Next check-in time
- Customer-facing status (yes/no)
```

Eli: For the IC role, can we define max single-task duration? e.g., IC should not be deep debugging >30m without rotating or pulling in a subject matter expert.

IncidentBot: Incident 1861229901 acknowledged in #incidents by @Ruchi. Pager escalation level: P1. Bridge link: https://meet.redwood/bridge/1861229901

Ruchi: adding that exactly — during yesterday's handoff I was still collecting logs and the oncoming IC had no quick summary.

Miguel: I'd propose action items:
- A1: Create abbreviated "IC first-10" card with commands (owner: Ana, due: 2026-03-22)
- A2: Add "handoff template" to runbook & add to off-shift playbook (owner: Jamie, due: 2026-03-19)
- A3: Add customer-impact rubric to oncall runbook (owner: Miguel, due: 2026-03-24)
- A4: Update incident-bot to post the runbook anchors in the initial page message (owner: Priya, due: 2026-03-26)

Ana (SRE): I'll draft the card. Anyone want to review before I post?

Priya: I'll wire up the bot change, small infra PR.

Eli: I'll write the "IC rotate after 30m" guideline and a short checklist for who to call as SMEs.

Jamie: Let's schedule a quick 30-min sync tomorrow to finalize wording. Who's available at 10:00 PT?

Miguel: I can.

Ruchi: can move my calendar.

Ana (SRE): yes

Priya: yes

Eli: yes

Jamie: OK booked — sent calendar invite. One more ask: add "post-incident customer comms owner" so CS isn't guessing who to reach out to.

Miguel: noted. We'll add a required field in handoff template: "CS lead".

IncidentBot: Reminder: Postmortem draft assigned to @Jamie. Due in 3 days. Link: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/1861229901

Jamie: thanks. I'll start the draft today; will include the checklist changes as appendix.

Ana (SRE): Quick question — should we make the "first-10" snippet part of the runbook root (index) so it's easy to copy? I vote yes.

Ruchi: +1

Priya: done — I'll make the bot include that index anchor when an incident is created.

Jamie: Perfect. Capturing final micro-actions:
- create card (Ana)
- handoff template update (Jamie)
- customer-impact rubric (Miguel)
- bot update (Priya)
- IC rotation guideline (Eli)

Jamie: closing loop here. If no objections I'll update the runbook after the sync and tag the PR for review.

Miguel: no objections :thumbsup:

Ruchi: :thumbsup: thanks everyone

Ana (SRE): logging A1 in Jira: https://jira.redwood/browse/OPS-4321

Priya: logging A4: https://jira.redwood/browse/OPS-4324

Eli: logging A5: https://jira.redwood/browse/OPS-4325

Jamie: thanks team — good improvements. We'll make the oncall flow less noisy and handoffs cleaner.
